needs.what: an op that removes a target spell from the stack straight to exile without it resolving or being countered (so it works on uncounterable spells), and leaves its owner the plotted permission: castable as a sorcery on a later turn without paying its mana cost
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_plot only marks a spell to be exiled and plotted when it resolves (and stack.py restricts that rider to spells cast from hand), so the spell would still resolve; counter with exiles counters rather than exiles, fails against uncounterable spells and leaves no plot permission; exile targets permanents/cards in zones, not stack items
